parts.text: State one natural and one man-made occurrence of oxides of nitrogen.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Under conditions of high pressure and a catalyst, nitrogen monoxide, $\text{NO}$, forms two other oxides of nitrogen, dinitrogen monoxide, $\text{N}_2\text{O}$, and dinitrogen trioxide, $\text{N}_2\text{O}_3$. $$\Delta G^{\ominus} = -102.8\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Balance the equation above for the formation of $\text{N}_2\text{O}$ and $\text{N}_2\text{O}_3$ from $\text{NO}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State how the oxidation number of nitrogen changes during this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the entropy change for the reaction at $298\text{ K}$. Include the units in your answer.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: State whether the sign of $\Delta S^{\ominus}$ calculated in (iii) agrees with that predicted from your balanced equation in (i). Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
A $1.00\text{ dm}^3$ flask at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is filled with pure $\text{N}_2\text{O}_3\text{(g)}$ at an initial pressure of $0.60\text{ atm}$. At equilibrium, the partial pressure of $\text{NO}_2\text{(g)}$ is $0.48\text{ atm}$.

Calculate the partial pressures of $\text{NO}\text{(g)}$ and $\text{N}_2\text{O}_3\text{(g)}$ at equilibrium. Hence calculate the value of $K_\text{p}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
$\text{NO}$ reacts readily with oxygen. $$2\text{NO}\text{(g)} + \text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\text{NO}_2\text{(g)}$$

The table shows how the initial rate of this reaction at $25^\circ\text{C}$ depends on the initial concentrations of the reactants.

| 0.0500 | 0.100 | 1.75 |
| 0.0500 | 0.0500 | 0.875 |

parts.label: (e)
parts.stem:
$\text{NO}$ reacts with iron pentacarbonyl, $\text{Fe(CO)}_5$, as shown. NO and CO are both monodentate ligands. $$\text{Fe(CO)}_5 + 2\text{NO} \rightarrow \text{Fe(CO)}_2\text{(NO)}_2 + 3\text{CO}$$

During this reaction the co-ordination number of the iron changes.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by the term co-ordination number.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Describe how the co-ordination number of the iron changes during this reaction.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text:
Only one stereoisomer of $\text{Fe(CO)}_2\text{(NO)}_2$ exists.

Use this information to suggest the geometry of the complex.
